note: Both sets duplicate the starlight-rejection and topological-charge-definition claims, but Set A additionally captures two well-supported facts that Set B omits: that the VVC is a phase-based coronagraph and the imprinted phase screw dislocation of form eilθ at the instrument focus. Set B's only extra claim, 'relationship to low-order aberration sensitivity: inverse', is a vague paraphrase that merely restates the sensitivity claim already present. Otherwise the two sets agree on the 4 m off-axis monolith, field amplitude zeroing, and charge/sensitivity trade-off, all correctly quoted.
